summary: Completed first-pass backend + frontend testing for Already Here Command OS (ProfitEngine v5 build). 15/15 backend pytest tests pass (health, revenue, agents, builds, deployments, content, audit, approvals, content factory ideas/connectors, AI script generation via Emergent LLM key with Gemini). Frontend Command Center (Overview), Content Factory (Studio), sidebar navigation, mobile hamburger menu, and Today's Profit badge all render correctly with no JS console errors. Cost compliance stats (Free Connectors / Manual Export / Paid Blocked) display correctly on Content Factory page.

minor.issue: ContentIdea pydantic model requires 'topic' field but route signature accepts dict; missing 'topic' returns generic 500 instead of 422 with field validation message. Frontend already sends topic correctly, but consider adding ContentIdeaCreate schema for stronger 422 errors.

issues: 'Revenue Intel' sidebar link points to /builds (Build Registry) page rather than a dedicated revenue intelligence page. Naming may confuse users. 'Income Streams' correctly points to /revenue.

action_items: (Optional/UX) Re-map 'Revenue Intel' sidebar nav entry or rename target to match /builds (Build Registry) to avoid confusion.
(Optional) Add explicit ContentIdeaCreate Pydantic input schema in /api/studio/ideas/ to return 422 with field validation instead of 500 when 'topic' missing.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/content_factory.py POST /ideas/ accepts raw dict and constructs ContentIdea(**idea) inside the handler — pydantic ValidationError bubbles up as 500. Use a dedicated Create schema for proper 422 responses.
server.py imports the global `db` lazily inside each route via `from server import db` — works but leads to fragile circular import. Prefer app.state.db usage with a single dependency.
Multiple routes repeat the same datetime str→datetime hydration boilerplate after find(). Consider a small helper to DRY this up (~10 occurrences).
Mongo `_id` is correctly excluded via projection `{"_id": 0}` in all list/get endpoints — good.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY confirmed working: AI script generation completed inside test timeout (≈few seconds).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (Overview, Studio, mobile sidebar, no JS errors)

test_credentials: None — no auth in this build
seed_data_creation: Two ideas were created during backend pytest with prefix TEST_ (TEST_Idea_From_Backend_Test, TEST_Script_Gen_Idea). One TEST UI idea attempt via Playwright was not submitted (button label 'New Content Idea', test selector used 'New Idea'). Test data is non-destructive; safe to leave or clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL works through Kubernetes ingress. All routes have trailing slashes. ContentIdea model requires title, description, topic — frontend ContentStudio.js correctly supplies all three. The 'New Content Idea' button label on /studio creates ideas via dialog with data-testid='idea-title-input', 'idea-description-input', 'idea-topic-input'. Sidebar mobile hamburger has data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle'. Pytest results XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found. Initial pytest failure on POST /api/studio/ideas/ was a missing 'topic' field in my test payload — the model legitimately requires it, and the frontend supplies it correctly. After adding 'topic' to test payload, all tests pass.
